title: A Space owner can connect their domain in one click through Domain Connect, instead of copying records

source.ref: The one-click method slot in DOMAIN_METHODS (owner ask 2026-10-06: fool-proof domains with one-click installs); white label sites build ADR-1708

detail: FILED 2026-10-06 by owner ask ("I also want one click installs"); RE-SCOPED the same day ("I can't afford Entri ... design something easy and consistent without a monthly service"). THE CONSEQUENCE: a client whose DNS is at GoDaddy, IONOS, Cloudflare, Squarespace or Vercel still copies records by hand (LIVE-743). THE FIX, no paid broker: Frequency's own Domain Connect template (the open standard Entri resells). One static template (apex A and www CNAME from the Vercel config API values; no variables), linted and submitted to github.com/Domain-Connect/Templates, signed with an RSA key (private key in Vercel env, public key as a _dck1 TXT on a Frequency domain), then onboarded with each DNS provider (Cloudflare by email to domain-connect@cloudflare.com; GoDaddy, IONOS and Vercel through their partner contacts). In app: discover support with a _domainconnect TXT lookup and the provider's settings JSON, show a Connect with <provider> button that redirects to the signed synchronous apply URL, and on return let the existing auto re-check confirm it. Every unsupported or not-yet-onboarded provider falls back to the copy-records flow, so the panel never dead-ends. LIFT: M, about 6 files (template JSON, signer, discovery, return route, panel button, tests), no migration, no monthly cost. OWNER STEPS: generate and save the signing key (walked through), add one TXT record, approve the template PR. External wait: provider onboarding, weeks per provider. Probe flips when the method is available. BUILT 2026-10-06 (claude/site-domain-connect): the template lib/sites/domain-connect/frequencylocal.com.website.json (providerId frequencylocal.com, serviceId website, apex A to %ip% and www CNAME to %target%; variables rather than fixed values because Vercel's recommended values are per project and change, and the signed URL keeps them tamper-proof), ids in constants.ts, a README on submitting it; signer.ts (RSA-SHA256 of the query string, key from env DOMAIN_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY, absent or bad key reads as not configured); apply-url.ts (the signed synchronous apply URL, sig then key=_dck1 last); discovery.ts (_domainconnect TXT, the provider settings JSON, the template check, 3 second timeouts, https to named hosts only, never throws); state.ts (HMAC-signed state carrying the Space slug, one hour); the return route app/api/sites/domain-connect/return lands the owner on /spaces/<slug>/manage?section=settings, an invalid state goes to the home page; the domainConnectLink server action re-gates the editor role and the custom_domain gate as connectSiteDomain does; the Domain section shows Connect with <provider> above the copy steps when supported and only the copy steps otherwise. Unit tests for all four modules. OWNER STEPS remaining: (1) generate an RSA key pair (openssl commands in the README); (2) put the private key in Vercel env DOMAIN_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY (Production); (3) add the public key as TXT records at _dck1.frequencylocal.com in the Domain Connect format p=1,a=RS256,d=<base64 DER part>; (4) submit the template as a PR to github.com/Domain-Connect/Templates; (5) email domain-connect@cloudflare.com and contact GoDaddy, IONOS and Vercel to onboard it. Until a provider onboards it, every domain gets the copy-records steps.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('lib/sites/domain-methods.ts','utf8');const m=s.match(/key: 'one-click'[\s\S]*?available: (true|false)/);if(!m||m[1]!=='true'){console.error('LIVE-780: one-click domain connect is not available yet (DOMAIN_METHODS one-click.available is false)');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails today: the one-click method is listed as coming. Passes when it is built and switched on.
